meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求进入 ultrawork 模式，Claude 会先显示『ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!』，然后按一套严格工作流程执行：先写失败测试再实现，用真实操作验证，记录笔记与目标，并根据任务轻重调整验证强度。
howto.when: 当你说出『ultrawork』或『ulw』时触发；若该模式的指令已在对话里，则不会重复读取。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修复登录页的报错。
say.note: 进入严格编码流程，先测试后修复。

say.text: 开启 ulw，把这个新接口写完并验证。
say.note: Claude 会先建失败测试，再实现并跑通。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，重构成三个模块。
say.note: 按 HEAVY 流程处理，多条件验证。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude starts by printing 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!' then follows a strict workflow: writes a failing test first, implements, verifies on a real surface, keeps a notepad and a registered goal, and scales verification by task weight.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user's prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. If the directive is already in the conversation, it is not read again.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix the login page error.
say_en.note: Enters strict coding flow, test then fix.

say_en.text: Enable ulw, build and verify this new API.
say_en.note: Claude creates failing tests first, then implements and runs it.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and refactor into three modules.
